## Summary

`smysl fmt` re-parsed its own formatted output on every file (`parse_surface(&formatted)` in `cmd_fmt`, `src/main.rs`) and compared records/labels back against the parse it started with, refusing to write if they'd moved. That guard could only fire on a bug in `write_surface` itself — no document a user could supply reaches it, as `tests/cmd_fmt.rs` already documented — so it was pure overhead: a full second parse per file for a check that could never fail on real input.

Changes:
- `src/main.rs`: removed the second `parse_surface` call and its comparison in `cmd_fmt`; updated the function doc comment and the `fmt` command's `--help` blurb to match.
- `tests/cmd_fmt.rs`: rewrote the comment explaining the removed guard and where the round-trip property is still verified (`smysl-core`'s `surface.rs`, `roundtrip.rs`, `versioning.rs`).
- `Documentation/manual/appendices.typ`, `CHANGELOG.md`: kept docs in sync with the new behavior.

`cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast` both pass. Not committed, per your instructions.
